help.title: Quick guide
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know — in one minute.
help.intro_body: A simple stock and sales tracker for your shop. Works on your phone or tablet without internet. Your data stays only on this device.
help.article_body: Tap the + Add tab at the bottom. Take a photo, type the name and sizes, set the cost and sale price, then Save.
help.sale_body: Find the article in Search, tap a size cell, choose Sell, and confirm. Stock for that size goes down, the sale shows up in the dashboard.
help.restock_body: Same as a sale — open the article, tap a size, but choose Restock. Stock goes up.
help.expense_body: Open the Dashboard tab and tap + Add expense. Pick a category (rent, transport, etc.), type the amount, save.
help.search_body: Type any part of the name, brand, or even color in your own language at the top of the Search tab. Recent searches stay there for quick re-use.
help.backup_body: Settings → Backup & sync → Export data. The file lands in your Downloads folder; share it to WhatsApp, Drive, or email so it lives somewhere safe.
help.auto_backup_body: Settings → Backup & sync → Auto-backup. Pick a folder once. The app silently saves a backup file there every time you change something. Pair the folder with Drive or Dropbox for cloud-like safety.
help.multi_device_body: Each phone or tablet has its own private inventory. To copy data: Export on one device, send the file to the other, then Import on the second device.
help.profile_body: Settings → Shop profile. Rename the shop, upload or change the logo, switch currency. The currency change does not convert existing prices — only how new ones are read.
help.install_body: On Android Chrome or desktop Chrome / Edge: Settings → Install as app, or use the browser menu (⋮ → Install app). On iPhone / iPad: tap Share → Add to Home Screen. The app gets its own icon and runs full-screen.
help.receive_body: Shop only. Tap Receive in the bottom nav to open the camera. Point at a product's barcode — if it's already in your catalogue, a small sheet asks for the quantity you're adding (and an optional expiry date). If the barcode is new, a quick form lets you create the article right there. Tap Type instead if the camera can't read the code.
help.sell_scan_title: Sell at the counter by scanning
help.sell_scan_body: Shop only. Tap Sell in the bottom nav to open the camera. Each scan adds one item to a cart at the bottom. Scan the same item twice to bump its quantity. Tap Done to finalise the sale — every item in the cart is recorded as one transaction.
help.lots_body: When you receive stock with an expiry date, the app remembers each batch as a Lot. When you sell that item, the oldest Lot is used first (FIFO). If you'd rather sell from a specific batch, open the article, tap Sell, and pick the lot from the dropdown.
help.alerts_body: Tap Alerts at the top of Search to see what needs attention. Two tabs: Stock running low (articles you set a reorder threshold for, currently below it) and Expiring soon (lots within your warning window). Hide for 7 days snoozes the alert; new alerts arriving in that window still surface immediately.
help.locations_body: Settings → Stock locations. Change the names of your front (display) and back (storage) zones to match how you talk about them in your shop. The new labels appear everywhere quantities are shown. Clear a field and save to restore the default for your language.
help.subtypes_custom_body: At onboarding (or anytime in Settings → Categories), you can add your own category labels alongside the predefined ones — e.g. tabac, halal_meat, bio. Custom labels are stored exactly as you type them and never auto-translate.
help.troubleshoot_title: If the app won't open or behaves strangely
help.troubleshoot_body: 1) Wait 10 seconds — a Clear cache & reload button appears if the app is stuck. 2) Open Settings → Maintenance to clear cached files without losing your data. 3) If you can't reach Settings, open your browser site settings and tap Clear & reset for inventar.hoodhood.ai. Your shop data is in the device's storage — only the app code is being refreshed.
help.footer_note: Lost or stuck? Open Settings → Maintenance for the safe clear option, or Settings → Reset everything for a full wipe. Back up first.
